_comment: Wallet attestations: trust the wallet providers on the
Commission's list (ETSI TS 119 602), signed under the CAs that
compose mounts at lote_signer_ca_path, instead of EU's trust
validator. The pinned wallet provider certificate, also mounted,
is only used without the list. render-oidc-config.py replaces
the list with WALLET_PROVIDERS_LOTE_URL when set, e.g. its
_empty twin for the Launchpad testbed's negative cases.
Revocation is off: EU's status validator rejects our status
DPoP allowlist for the `htu` claim. A token request whose URL is
not listed is rejected, so this must name the token endpoint as
the wallet sees it, through the proxy and with the prefix.
